arc.opening: You mentioned a cabin your family used to visit.

turns.text: You mentioned a cabin your family used to visit every summer. What's one morning there that's stuck with you?
My grandmother always had coffee going before any of us were up. The whole cabin smelled like it, even out on the dock.
Coffee already going before any of us were up — that's such a specific kind of quiet to remember. Tell me more about her out there on the dock with that cup.

annotations.quoted_span: before any of us were up

turns.text: Every morning, as far as I remember. She'd already be out on the dock with her cup by the time I got up.

The cabin smelled like your grandmother's coffee before either of you said a word — that's the whole morning in one detail. Thank you for letting me sit in it with you. I'll keep this filed right next to the dock story and the loons.

annotations.takeaway: The cabin smelled like your grandmother's coffee before either of you said a word.
